description: A pink bowl sits in the middle with a small dark piece above it, and nearby are a yellow cheese-shaped cutout, a pink-and-white ring, a bacon-shaped strip, and a wooden block. The left hand stays resting near the lower left, while the right hand reaches in from the right toward the small dark piece, pinches and lifts it, then moves over the bowl and drops it inside before pulling back with no object in hand.
